texto: Single small wooden button click, tiny dry tap, close-mic, no reverb
Short crisp flick of a stiff paper sewing pattern, dry close-mic foley, no reverb
Two dull muffled thuds on a soft pin cushion, low and soft, dry close-mic foley
Quick swish of sewing thread pulled through fabric ending with a tiny needle tick, sewing foley, dry, no reverb
Muffled punch into a soft stuffed toy, pillow thump with slight cloth rustle, dry close-mic foley, no reverb
Heavy muffled punch into a stuffed rag doll with a seam cracking, deep pillow thump, dry close-mic foley, no reverb
Thick fabric ripping violently, then a soft pop of stuffing bursting out, cloth tear foley, dry, close-mic, no reverb
A metal sewing thimble flicked once with a fingernail, clear bright metallic ting that rings briefly, close-mic, dry
A needle clinking off a small metal thimble followed by a dull soft cloth thud, short dry foley
Soft airy swish of light tulle fabric whipping past, gentle whoosh, dry, no reverb
A taut thread suddenly going slack with a soft descending twang, small, dry close-mic
Two quick soft cloth footsteps followed by a short fabric slide on a wooden table, dry close-mic foley
Single sheet of paper flipped over quickly, light crisp, dry close-mic foley
Small sewing scissors snipping a single thread, tiny crisp snip, dry close-mic foley
A taut thread stretching and creaking under tension, eerie string strain, then one deep muffled heartbeat thump, dry
Limp rag doll flopping down onto a wooden table, soft cloth thump followed by one tiny button clack, dry foley
Old heavy metal scissors creaking as they slowly open, rusty hinge squeak, short, dry foley
Huge heavy tailor shears snapping shut once, loud sharp metallic snip with a short metal ring, dramatic, dry close-mic foley
A needle and thread pulled through thick cloth three times quickly, three short swishes, sewing foley, dry close-mic
